title: Check the head commit trailer block in cheap preflight
body:
Lesson from PR #135: a lead commit message separated Ticket from Co-Authored-By with a blank line, so git interpret-trailers saw no Ticket trailer; only krn ship's verifier caught it after review, which forced a third review panel under an operator D10 exception.
Acceptance: npm run preflight fails when the head commit's final trailer block does not parse exactly one Ticket trailer (and every Change-contract trailer sits in that block), with a frozen observer RED on base and GREEN on head. No new preflight framework.
